summary: Verified the emoji/mojibake fix in AdminPage WhatsApp message templates. Logged in as admin1/admin123, opened Verifikasi Pembayaran tab, intercepted window.open on both the verified-order WA button (data-testid wa-*) and the reminder button (data-testid remind-*). Decoded the ?text= param for both and asserted no U+FFFD and no codepoints > 0x2700, while the expected plain-text fields are present.
critical_code_review_comments: orderProgress() in AdminPage.js still contains emoji glyphs in Belum cek payment (⚠) and Complete (✅) status labels. These render as UI text (not WhatsApp) so are not part of this bug, but if the mojibake was caused by a source-encoding issue those characters could still be at risk. Consider replacing with lucide-react icons for consistency.
AdminPage.js is 1126 lines; consider splitting per feature (payment table, users, logs, checkin, walkin) into separate modules.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing verified order #1362 (name 'a', seat D9) and existing pending/expired order #2148 (SUELLY LIO NARD).
context_for_next_testing_agent: WhatsApp buttons live in the payment/verification table. Verified button: button[data-testid^='wa-']. Reminder button: button[data-testid^='remind-']. Override window.open BEFORE clicking; do NOT store ElementHandles because the table re-renders after admin API calls (detached-DOM error) — use page.locator(...).first.click() instead.
rca of the issue: Verified bug fix. Decoded WhatsApp message text for VERIFIED order (#1362): contains 'No. Order:', 'Nama:', 'Kursi:', 'Sekretariat MBI Kepri'; no U+FFFD; no chars > 0x2700. Decoded reminder message (#2148): contains 'No. Order:', '/order/<uuid>', 'Sekretariat MBI Kepri'; no U+FFFD; no chars > 0x2700. Only non-ASCII characters remaining are the safe em-dash (U+2014) in '— Sekretariat MBI Kepri'. Bug fix is confirmed working.
